Commercial scope (summary): handle a lot of day-to-day operations, sourcing beans, staffing help, and social media This agreement sets the rules for the parties’ mobile coffee cart business so the relationship stays clear as the business grows. Party A owns the trailer/cart setup, espresso machine, grinder, generator, and most startup equipment now, and those items stay Party A’s personal property unless both parties sign a written transfer. Party B will handle a substantial share of day-to-day operations, bean sourcing, staffing help, and social media. The parties will run the business under the agreed brand name and keep control of the business social media accounts for the business only. They will keep accurate books, track inventory purchases, and treat the business as a shared venture with defined ownership, decision rights, payout rules, and exit rights. If one party stops working, becomes sick or disabled, dies, materially breaches, or otherwise creates serious problems for the business, the agreement gives the other party a clear path to protect the business and buy out the affected interest.
